g.text: Select Supervisor assignment and registered UAV
Draw or edit a survey sector
Retain other sector drafts on the map
Assigned operator saves selected sector as DRAFT
Initialize isolated world near first waypoint
Receive telemetry or command / lifecycle event
Save final attempt and coverage snapshot
Asynchronous monitoring and commands are summarized
in one event loop. Rejected commands leave state unchanged.
DRAFT / READY cannot be cancelled. Terminal missions
